primary_estimand: Effect of one intense 1 h skating bout on whole-blood gene expression (after vs before exercise, same skater), on day 18 of altitude adaptation, in 7 elite female speed skaters. Paired within-subject estimand; the paper's altitude-specificity claim needs external microarray data outside this series.
sample_inclusion: All 14 RNA-seq samples (7 skaters x before/after exercise)
matrix_scale: RSEM expected counts (estimated counts) from the paper's RSEM gene table
paper_method: DESeq2 with design ~ donor + exercise, on the RSEM per-gene table

paper_threshold.adjustment: not_reported (paper says FDR < 0.1; DESeq2 default BH applied by executor)
